Name: Prince Lindworm Monster and Farm Animal
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
[color=#e1e1e1][size=4]Lindworm Monster[/size][/color]
Adds in the Lindworm to the skull caverns. The Lindworm also has a prince variant that sometimes drops its crown for you to wear. The Lindworms are slightly stronger than the Pepper Rex and behave in the same way, though they have their unique drops.Lindworm drops:
[list=1]
[*]Bug meat[/*]
[*]Lindworm egg[/*]
[*]Large milk[/*]
[*]Gold bar[/*]
[*]Garlic[/*]
[/list][size=4]﻿Coop Animal[/size]
You can put the Lindworm egg into the incubator in the coop to hatch your very own Lindworm. It will take 10 days to mature and 3 days to produce, and produces by dropping items on the ground (like chickens).Lindworm Produce:
[list=1]
[*]Lindworm egg[/*]
[*]Milk[/*]
[*]Large Milk[/*]
[*]Gold ore[/*]
[*]Gold bar[/*]
[/list]
